snippet.title: FDS Longplay [012] Chitei Tairiku Orudoora
snippet.description:
http://www.longplays.org

Played by: KAGE-008

Developed by SunSoft. Some sort of Japanese educational game where you go through 30 levels, in almost each of them defeating small goblins by solving math problems, needing at least 3 correct answers to progress.

BONUS at 46:41 — I included Step Drill, a minigame where a motorcycle driver wants to travel across the European continent, but for that you need to solve math problems correctly, five in each step.

Disclaimer: Most videos by World of Longplays use SaveStates!
